notes.title: See us at Vancouver Game Garden this weekend!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Launch went well, and we're so happy there are people out there enjoying Flowerdrops! We also put out a couple small patches to address a few bugs that came up.[/p][p][b]This weekend (September 27th and 28th), a couple of us are going to be at [url="https://vangamegarden.com/"]Vancouver Game Garden[/url]![/b] This is a (free) event where we'll be showing Flowerdrops at a booth alongside 40+ other indie devs and their games. Natali will also be giving a talk about prototyping in GameMaker on Saturday at 3pm![/p][p][b]We'll be debuting a brand-new mode in Flowerdrops — the Game Garden Gauntlet![/b] This is a score-chasing curated playlist of Flowerdrops levels, and the highest scorers will receive free copies of the game (already have it? win a copy for a friend!).[/p][p]While this mode will be event-only for a little while here, we're hoping to figure out a nice way to integrate a more robust version into the regular game so that everyone can have fun with it.[/p][p]Anyway, thanks for your support, and we hope to see you at VGG if you're in the area![/p][p]— Studio Cozy Zone [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657383/337f3e79c96db4e52e0ab702b1700f4ef835a37a.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where restarting a Robo-Cloud level while in the "interior" levels caused the wrong theme to be displayed
[*] Fixed a few themes that were rendering incorrectly on some devices
[*] Fixed a bug caused by Sand Blocks landing on collectables
[/list]

[b]Other changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] New version of Gravity Gulch
[*] New Ice-themed level for the title screen
[*] Refinements to various Robo-Cloud interior stages
[*] A handful of small tweaks to other misc level across the game
[/list]
